notes.title: Tall Trails + Henry Halfhead Bundle Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, gamers![/p][p]I'm happy to share that Tall Trails is now available in bundle with the newly released indie game [b]Henry Halfhead[/b]! It's the [b]"Boot Everything + Become Everything" [/b]bundle![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58534/Boot_Everything__Become_Everything/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Henry Halfhead is a quirky sandbox adventure game about an odd little character with the ability to become any object within their reach![/p][p]If you played Tall Trails and were yearning to not just launch things from your boot, but to BECOME them.. then check the bundle out! You can get both games together for 10% off.[/p][p]Brady[/p]

notes.title: [1.0.4] Patch Notes - QOL + bug squashing
notes.notes: [p]Greetings gamers![/p][p]I just pushed up version 1.0.4 of Tall Trails![/p][list][*][p]Added a toggle for "Camera Follow" to the settings menu. Turning it off should help the folks that get nausea from the camera automatically turning towards Alp[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could get caught in a loop if you fell off a structure in the final level without any stamina left[/p][/*][*][p]Bunny Badge is now \[-20%, -26%, -32%, -40%] stamina cost reduction, previously was \[-25%, -35%, -40%, -50%]*[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual issue with the Sorcerer's Tower windows looking bad when seen from under water[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could get trapped inside "Stilt Village" proc-gen structure[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports![/p][p]Brady[/p][p][/p][p]* (Re: Bunny Badge: much as I hate to balance things in this game, it was possible to climb-jump for free with just Bunny+3 and a Mirror+3, pretty OP compared to other badges.)[/p]

notes.title: [1.0.3] Patch Notes - Bug Fixes & Small Fun Things!
notes.notes: [p]Hello all![/p][p]I just pushed up version 1.0.3 of Tall Trails![/p][p]This patch addresses a few bugs, plus makes some fun little changes that I had wanted to make pre-launch that I didn't have a chance to fit in! Hope you enjoy![/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Boot Badge didn't work past 10 items[/p][/*][*][p]Made a change to how birds work ,')[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Giant Hands" trapping players inside[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the "Bug Report View" not being navigable on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the main menu sometimes wouldn't reopen after you submitted a bug report[/p][/*][*][p]Brought something back[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some more typos[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports![/p][p]Brady[/p]

notes.title: Tall Trails Soundtrack Available Now!
notes.notes: [p]Hello folks![/p][p]If you've been enjoying the music of Tall Trails, I have great news for ya--the Soundtrack, composed by Dylan Payne, is now available on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3933340/Tall_Trails_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink]If you already own the game, you can purchase the "Game + Soundtrack" bundle for a nice 10% discount![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58027/Tall_Trails__Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink]Buying the OST is a great way to support Dylan Payne, the incredibly talented musician behind Tall Trails' music! So you should do that![/p][p]Thanks guys ,') ![/p][p]Brady[/p]

notes.title: [1.0.2] Another small patch!
notes.notes: [p]Hello folks![/p][p]I just pushed up version 1.0.2 of Tall Trails![/p][p]It's a very small patch to fix a bug that was introduced in v1.0.1. Bugs begat bugs![/p][p]Changelog:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain proc-gen islands with ziplines on them would fail to load properly[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports![/p][p]Brady[/p]

notes.title: [1.0.1] A small patch!
notes.notes: [p]Hello folks![/p][p]I just pushed up version 1.0.1 of Tall Trails! It's mostly addressing bugs you guys have found over the last few days. [/p][p]Changelog:[/p][list][*][p]Added a lil ~randomization~ to something that happens at the end of the game when playing in New Game+ or Randomizer mode[/p][/*][*][p]Made the trigger for winning the Blimp Race bigger & taller, so it will be a little easier to hit when approaching it at near lightspeed[/p][/*][*][p]Added some playtesters to the credits whose names accidentally dropped off the list. Sorry about that![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "T-Rex Fossil" & "Desk Lamp" statues trapping players inside[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where returning clay to Cupp from a world other than the one you're currently in would not be saved properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where if you summitted, but didn't collect the clay, the clay wouldn't respawn when loading the island again[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain proc-gen islands would fail to load properly[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some typos[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports![/p][p]Brady[/p]

notes.title: Tall Trails featured in Tiny Teams & Wholesome Games Celebration!
notes.notes: [p]Hi folks,[/p][p][/p][p]Brady here! I want to take a moment to thank you all for an amazing launch![/p][p]It's made me so happy to read your reviews and to see the various ways you've absolutely broken my little game :')[/p][p]Also, I am happy to share that Tall Trails is participating in 2 events this week![/p][list][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]Tiny Teams[/url], a lovely festival devoted to games made by teams of 5 or less! Briony & Lydia from [b]The Yogscast [/b]will be streaming the game 8/14![/p][/*][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames"]Wholesome Games Celebration[/url] is for cozy games! I don't know how Tall Trails managed to get in, seeing as it is so gritty and violent, but def check out the other chill games![/p][/*][/list][p]I'll also be pushing a small patch up soon with a some bug fixes![/p][p]Anyways, thanks again my friends![/p][p][/p][p]Brady[/p]

notes.title: Tall Trails is coming August 4th!
notes.notes: [p]Hi folks![/p][p][/p][p]Very excited to share that after 3+ years of dev, Tall Trails has a release date: the game will be going live August 4th![/p][p]The game features a 4 - 5 hour main story, 5 different biomes full of unique items you can use to move & explore, and infinite randomly generated islands you can explore after you're done with the main game! It's going to cost $10 USD.[/p][p]So psyched to finally get this game out into the world. See you all quite soon![/p][p][/p][p]-Brady[/p]

notes.title: [v.0.8.1] Fixing Demo Bugs!
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

Huge thanks to everyone who's played the demo so far, the response has been wonderful!

I'm uploading a new build to fix some user reported bugs.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the game to break when running on a computer with Spanish set as the primary language
[*] Fixed a bug that caused erasing your saves in slot #2 or slot #3 to also erase your world data in slot #1
[/list]
Thanks to everyone who reported bugs! If you find a bug, you can report it via the "Pause" menu while using mouse & keyboard.

- Brady

notes.title: Tall Trails Free Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

I'm super excited to say that the Tall Trails demo is now available on Steam! Pushing it up a little bit before Next Fest. :-)

The demo has about an hour of gameplay. You'll explore 4 islands full of weird little guys, crazy items you can use to explore, and even more weird little guys!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3028520/Tall_Trails_Demo/

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2393760/ss_ae782a56b2b876407b538433d6bbc171076d1538.1920x1080.jpg?t=1740071792[/img]

I hope you enjoy! This has been years in the making, and I'm thrilled to finally have it in front of you all!

- Brady
